privacy.title: Lio Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: This Privacy Policy describes how Lio ("we", "our" or "us") collects, uses, and shares information when you use our mobile application (the "App"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about our data practices.
privacy.infoDirectIntro: When you complete the onboarding process, we collect:
privacy.infoDirectBasic: Basic profile information: Name and age
privacy.infoDirectPrefs: Affirmation preferences: Categories you select and your preferred affirmations
privacy.infoDirectNotifs: Notification preferences: If you enable notifications, frequency (notifications per day) and preferred time windows
privacy.infoDirectWidget: Widget usage: If you install the iOS widget
privacy.infoDirectPremium: Premium subscription data: Information about your trial and subscription status
privacy.infoAutoDevice: Device information: Platform (iOS), OS version, and app version
privacy.infoAutoAnalytics: Usage analytics: How you interact with the app, collected through PostHog analytics
privacy.infoAutoCrash: Crash and performance data: Technical information about app crashes and errors, collected through Sentry
privacy.infoAutoSession: Session recordings: PostHog may record user sessions to help us improve the app experience
privacy.infoAutoPurchase: Purchase information: Subscription and payment data processed through RevenueCat and Apple's payment systems
privacy.infoAutoAds: Conversion tracking data: Device identifiers (IDFA on iOS when permission is granted) and app events collected through TikTok Pixel for advertising measurement
privacy.infoLocalTitle: 3. Information Stored Locally on Your Device
privacy.infoLocalIntro: The following data is stored only on your device and is not transmitted to our servers:
privacy.infoLocalStreak: Daily streak tracking data (currently local; future updates may sync with backend servers)
privacy.howUseIntro: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
privacy.howUseService: Service provision: To provide you with personalized affirmations and notifications based on your preferences
privacy.howUseImprove: App improvement: To analyze usage patterns and improve the functionality, design, and user experience of the app
privacy.howUseSupport: Customer support: To respond to your comments and support requests
privacy.howUseSubs: Subscription management: To process and manage your premium subscription
privacy.howUseErrors: Error monitoring: To identify and fix technical issues and errors
privacy.howUseComms: Communication: To send you important updates about the app (if you have opted in)
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: We use the following third-party services that may collect information:
privacy.tpRevenueCatData: Data shared: User identifier, purchase information, subscription status
privacy.tpSupabasePurpose: Purpose: Backend database to store onboarding responses and feedback (future implementation)
privacy.tpSupabaseData: Data shared: All onboarding information mentioned above, associated with your RevenueCat user ID
privacy.tpSentryPurpose: Purpose: Error tracking and performance monitoring
privacy.tpSentryData: Data shared: Error logs, device information, IP address, and user context
privacy.tpPostHogPurpose: Purpose: Product analytics and session recording
privacy.tpPostHogData: Data shared: Usage patterns, user interactions, session replays, device information
privacy.tpAppleData: Data shared: Payment information, purchase history (managed directly by Apple)
privacy.tpTikTokPurpose: Purpose: Conversion tracking and advertising measurement
privacy.tpTikTokData: Data shared: Device identifiers (IDFA on iOS when permission is granted), app events (such as installs, purchases, and custom events)
privacy.tpTikTokOptOut: Opt-out: You can opt out of TikTok tracking through iOS App Tracking Transparency (ATT) settings by denying tracking permission when prompted or going to Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking on your iOS device
privacy.retentionAccount: Account data: We retain your onboarding data as long as you use the app. You can request deletion at any time.
privacy.retentionAnalytics: Analytics data: Analytics and error tracking data are retained according to the policies of our third-party providers (typically 90 days to 2 years).
privacy.retentionLocal: Local data: Data stored on your device remains until you uninstall the app or clear app data.
privacy.securityIntro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information, including:
privacy.securityTls: Encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS) for all data transmission
privacy.securityStorage: Secure storage practices for data on our servers
privacy.securityAccess: Limited access to personal data only by authorized personnel
privacy.securityWarning: However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.rightsIntro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
privacy.rightsAccess: Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
privacy.rightsCorrect: Correction: Request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
privacy.rightsDelete: Deletion: Request the deletion of your personal data
privacy.rightsPortable: Portability: Request your data in a portable format
privacy.rightsOptOutAds: Opt-out: Opt out of analytics and marketing communications
privacy.rightsOptOutTracking: Tracking Opt-out: iOS users can opt out of TikTok conversion tracking and other ad tracking via App Tracking Transparency (ATT) settings (Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking)
privacy.rightsWithdrawConsent: Withdraw consent: Withdraw consent for data processing where we rely on consent
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise these rights, contact us at the email address provided below.
privacy.childrenText: The App is not intended for children under 13 years of age (or the applicable age of digital consent in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, contact us immediately.
privacy.pushIntro: The app uses local push notifications to deliver affirmations based on your preferences. These notifications are:
privacy.pushBased: Based on the categories and preferences you select
privacy.pushOptional: Completely optional and can be disabled at any time via app or device settings
privacy.pushNoAds: Not used to send marketing messages or advertising
privacy.changesIntro: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by:
privacy.changesPost: Posting the new Privacy Policy in the app
privacy.changesNotify: Sending a notification (if required by law)
privacy.changesAccept: Your continued use of the app after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
privacy.gdprIntro: As this app is operated from Spain and directed to users in the European Union and Latin America, we comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.gdprRightsIntro: As an EU resident, you have the following rights:
privacy.gdprAccess: Right of access (Article 15): Obtain confirmation of data processing and access to your data
privacy.gdprRectify: Right to rectification (Article 16): Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
privacy.gdprForget: Right to erasure (Article 17): Request the deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
privacy.gdprRestrict: Right to restriction (Article 18): Limit how we use your data
privacy.gdprPortable: Right to data portability (Article 20): Receive your data in a structured and machine-readable format
privacy.gdprObject: Right to object (Article 21): Object to processing based on legitimate interests
privacy.gdprWithdraw: Right to withdraw consent: Withdraw consent at any time without affecting prior processing
privacy.gdprComplain: Right to lodge a complaint: Lodge a complaint with the AEPD (Spanish Data Protection Agency) in Spain or your local supervisory authority
privacy.gdprAuthorityIntro: For users in Spain, the supervisory authority is:
privacy.gdprAepdAddress: Address: C/ Jorge Juan, 6, 28001 Madrid, Spain
privacy.gdprAuthorityOutro: For users in other EU countries or Latin America, contact your local data protection authority.
privacy.contactIntro: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, including exercising your GDPR rights, contact us at:
privacy.contactDetails: For GDPR-related requests, clearly indicate "GDPR Request" in the subject of your email and specify which right you wish to exercise. We will respond within one month from receipt of your request, as required by GDPR.
privacy.cookiesText: The App does not use cookies. However, our third-party analytics providers (PostHog) may use similar technologies for analytical purposes. You can control these through your device settings.
privacy.footerNote: By using the Lio app, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to the collection, use, and sharing of your information as described here.
